replace:
-- [AP25: double-click open] playlist: with the mouse the first click only selects the row, a second click on it within 0.6 s opens it (Enter opens at once)
					if opts.type == 'playlist' and event.is_pointer and not event.modifiers and not event.action then
						_G.ap_click = _G.ap_click or {idx = nil, t = -100}
						local now = mp.get_time()
						if _G.ap_click.idx ~= event.index or now - _G.ap_click.t > 0.6 then
							_G.ap_click.idx, _G.ap_click.t = event.index, now
							return
						end
						_G.ap_click.idx = nil
					end
					opts.on_activate(event --[[@as MenuEventActivate]])
					if not event.modifiers and not event.action then cleanup_and_close() end
